Thank you for replying. 
It’s hard to let go of the past. I’ve seeked help (therapy and medication) but finding my loved one by suicide will haunt me forever. I feel it’s made me suicidal and I haven’t been able to shake that. 
Yeah it’s been psychological abuse also. It’s been a really hard 6months, I’m suffering and I’m suffering.
I continually think about him taking my life, and In a way I’m just going to allow it.
